name: sokonanoda-dsh
description: Unified DeepSeek Harness language-service plugin for sokonanoda: an automatic local fast path for quiz turns (llm/stream, no model provider), display-only learn cards rendered from Markdown fences (question / knowledge / lesson), and Lean syntax highlighting. Runtime config, quiz progress and history live in ~/.dsh/state/sokonanoda-dsh/, never in the repository.
